name: The Manor
source:
Chris loves Martin, Martin loves spirits. And ghosts. And demons. And poltergeists. And... well, you get the idea, right?

A temporary job at Ashland Manor might be exactly what the two of them need!

[From [url=https://ertal-games.itch.io/the-manor]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
克里斯爱马丁，马丁爱烈酒。还有鬼魂。还有恶魔。还有恶作剧鬼。而且……好吧，你明白了，对吧？

阿什兰庄园的一份临时工作或许正是他们两人所需要的！

[来自[url=https://ertal-games.itch.io/the-manor]Itch.io[/url]]
